bundle.shortDescription: AI-assisted Delta DVP PLC code generator
bundle.longDescription: Delta PLC AI Generator (DPA) generates Structured Text (ST) and Instruction List (IL) code for Delta DVP Series PLCs from natural-language descriptions. Includes address conflict detection, ladder diagram rendering, and export to ISPSoft (XML) and DOPSoft (CSV) formats.
